The '''Exclusive Raffle''' is a feature in [[Pet Simulator 99]]. The raffle is available through [[The Forever Pack (Pet Simulator 99)|The Forever Pack]] in the [[Exclusive Shop (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Shop]]. All pets in the Exclusive Raffle can appear in all rarities: Golden, Rainbow, and Shiny. 

== How it Works ==
Each round of the Exclusive Raffle randomly selects one pet to be raffled off. Players can submit ''Exclusive Raffle Tickets'' to enter for a chance to win the pet, with 1 ticket equating to one entry. Only '''one player wins per round''', and each raffle lasts '''30 minutes'''. Pets for the next 3 upcoming raffles are displayed.

Exclusive Raffle Tickets can be obtained by:
* Earning tickets through the Forever Pack.
* Weekly Pack Rewards.
* Buying 35 or 170 Exclusive Eggs.
* Buying 30 Exclusive Card Packs.
* Purchasing an [[MVP Subscription (Pet Simulator 99)|MVP]] subscription.

The Winners tab displays every raffle that occurred within the past 48 hours, as well as the player who won and the amount of tickets they entered.
